title: An entry's detail page sets the browser tab title to Library Part
custom_preconds: Env https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com (S2 shop; locations Staging Heavy Duty and Staging Lethbridge). Current location Staging Heavy Duty. Logged in as Admin (or a default Parts Manager): Part Library & Inventory View, Create & Edit and Delete, and See Financial Data. Data: QAPL-T1. Desktop browser, window 1440 px.
custom_steps:
1. Parts > Part Library (parts_nav_catalog).
  2. Click the QAPL-T1 row.
  3. Reload the detail page (F5).
  4. Click the pencil, read the window title, then close it with the X.
  5. Press the browser Back button.
custom_expected:
1. The page title and the browser tab read "Part Library"; the URL is /parts/parts-catalogue.
  2. The entry's detail page opens (/parts-catalogue/{id}); the browser tab reads "Library Part", with no "Catalog" wording.
  3. The tab still reads "Library Part".
  4. The window is titled "Edit Library Part"; the tab stays "Library Part".
  5. The list is back; the tab reads "Part Library", with no "Catalog" wording.
